sceneId.description: The single supplied sceneId, copied exactly.

summary.description: A concrete present-tense summary naming the scene's on-page action.

focalCharacterName.description: A name copied from known_cast when one perspective clearly leads; otherwise null.

dramaticFunction.description: The specific job this scene performs in the episode's developing story.

conflict.description: The scene's immediate opposition or pressure. For a connective scene, state that there is no independent confrontation and name the pressure carried forward.

stakes.description: What can be gained, lost, exposed, or made harder by the scene's action.

turnBeatId.description: The allowed beatId where the scene's main change is clearest.

turn.description: The concrete change in information, decision, value, or power by scene end.

beatId.description: A beatId copied from allowedBeatIds for the supplied scene.

summary.description: Concrete on-page action or decision at this moment; never a placeholder.

dramaticFunction.description: How this moment changes pressure, information, power, or choice in the scene.

consequence.description: What becomes newly true or must be addressed after this moment.

keyMoments.description: One or more decisive on-page moments, each tied to an allowed beatId.
